research_task.title: Verify a materially delivered manifest-pinned orbit bundle

summary: The delivery prerequisite fails: two confined non-executing enumerations found only the pre-existing research brief and three reviewer-authored records, with no supplier-authored digest manifest or orbit-pruning payload, so coverage validation and every execution stage remain unavailable.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the directly linked prior contribution, this fresh attempt independently reproduces the missing-delivery obstruction; the advertised materially delivered bundle did not occur. It adds a digest-identified inventory plus independent root-boundary, alternate-stream, and embedded-payload indicator checks.
value_assessment.evidence: A hidden-aware root inventory and an independent filesystem enumeration each returned four ordinary files and no directory; timestamps identify one pre-existing brief and three later reviewer records. The brief has a recorded SHA-256 digest, one ordinary data stream, and no code fence, 64-hex digest, Lean filename, Lean/Lake project marker, or common Base64 ZIP/GZIP marker. The final proposal passed structural contract validation.
value_assessment.falsifier: A confined enumeration showing a pre-review supplier-authored digest manifest or payload, or evidence of a payload stream or embedded archive missed by both enumerations and the declared content checks, would overturn the scoped result.

claims.statement: Within the observable fresh attempt directory during this review, no supplier-authored top-level SHA-256 manifest or orbit-pruning payload was present, so manifest coverage and digest verification could not begin and no contributed code was eligible for execution.
claims.evidence_summary: Two independent confined enumerations found only one pre-existing brief and three later reviewer-authored records, with no directory or candidate manifest. The brief has one ordinary data stream and lacks digest, code-fence, project-marker, and common encoded-archive indicators.
claims.verification_method: Repeat hidden-inclusive root enumeration through both the shell provider and filesystem API, classify entries by timestamps and role, inspect alternate streams, hash the sole supplied file, and rerun the bounded content-pattern checks without executing contributed content.

limitations: The claim concerns only the observable permitted attempt directory and not artifacts that may exist elsewhere.
The embedded-content checks do not exclude every possible steganographic or custom encoding.
This is a pre-build delivery obstruction; no source was compiled and no declaration, axioms, replay, count, or mutation behavior was tested.
No conclusion about the Riemann Hypothesis or any zeta zero is made.
failed_approaches: The planned full audit could not start because the prerequisite manifest and payload were absent.
Independent enumeration and bounded concealed-payload checks did not reveal an alternate delivery route.
next_actions: Supply the exact complete bundle behind a supplier-authored top-level SHA-256 manifest in a fresh permitted attempt.
After delivery, execute the ordered offline coverage, digest, build, axiom, double-replay, and two-mutation protocol.

proposed_tasks.title: Deliver and audit the exact manifest-pinned orbit bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Materially place the complete orbit-pruning payload and its top-level SHA-256 manifest in a fresh permitted attempt, then run the ordered offline verification protocol.
proposed_tasks.rationale: Repeated reviews stop at the same delivery prerequisite, so execution is meaningful only after exact attributable bytes are present.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Every required file is manifest-covered with a matching digest; the offline build and axiom audit satisfy the declared contract; two clean replays agree; and changed-input and changed-count mutations are rejected.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Preserve the first coverage gap, digest mismatch, offline dependency or compiler failure, unexpected axiom, declaration mismatch, replay disagreement, count mismatch, or accepted mutation.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Inventory without execution, validate manifest coverage and SHA-256 digests, build without networking, print declarations and axioms, replay twice from clean generated state, then run separate input and count mutations.
